receipts.detail: Reproduces the exact first causal divergence where 4 joining nodes stall on node_ready_lease_incomplete / incomplete priority spread (spreadGap > 0) and proves the causal mechanism.

Covers the 4 historical failure families (formation-voter-surplus-promotion-deferral-livelock, formation-ledger-spread-completion-self-move-interlock-deadlock, over-target-cap-spread-cure-wipe, formation-release-handoff-closure-v4).
The same composed witness preserves surplus/concurrent-operation safety (never exceeding over-target cap or dropping below quorum) and progresses after finite failure clears.

Proves that when the blocking condition genuinely persists (e.g. target node remains unreachable or voter surplus cannot be safely promoted), safety holds and premature release/unsafe move is refused.
Proves that progress occurs within unchanged timeout/deadline bounds via an owned canonical wake (no widened deadlines, no polling fallback, no harness state injection).
An approving subagent verification newer than the last attempt, read through the solve store owner.
